description:
Checks an MCP server address for an agent, paid per call: what we measured, the catalog listings and the domain facts.
The answer of `GET /api/check`, sold per call to agents, with no account and no allowance before. A request without payment gets the 402 with the price; a paid one gets the check in the same response, with the payment in `cobranca`. The check never visits the address. When the check is unavailable, the answer is 503 and nothing is charged.

url.description: The http(s) endpoint of the MCP server, without credentials.
